summary: Invoke a callback for each present element in ascending order and always return undefined.

target.notes: Snapshot length, skip absent indices, Get each present value at visit time, invoke callback through JsFunction.Call with (value, index, array), ignore the callback return value, then return JsUndefined.Value.

semantics.callback_this: thisArg or undefined via canonical call semantics
semantics.callback_callable_check: TypeError before iteration if callback is not callable

caveats: List<T>.ForEach does not supply index/array arguments and has different behavior under structural mutation.
Exceptions thrown by the callback must propagate immediately after prior callback side effects.

tests.name: deletion before visit skips that index
tests.input: const a=[1,2,3]; const seen=[]; a.forEach((v,i)=>{seen.push(v); if(i===0)delete a[1]}); console.log(seen.join(','));

tests.name: thisArg is passed through JS call semantics
non-callable callback throws even when no elements would be visited
